Subject: Publicity & Logo Use — Order Form redlines and confidentiality timing

Hi John,

Thanks for the productive call this morning. Attached is the latest Order Form (OrderForm_v3.pdf) with the publicity and logo-use sections pulled out for clarity. Two quick asks we discussed:

- Can Acme confirm the desired embargo window for press announcements after go-live? You mentioned "no public mention until customer-facing product announcement," but we need a specific number of days to reflect in the Order Form.
- You flagged wanting a stronger confidentiality carveout around early product screenshots and quote attribution. If you can share a redline (or high-level bullets), we can translate into contract language.

We've looped in Ben (marketing ops) and Marissa (legal intake) so they see the timing constraints. From Redwood's side, standard approach is: 30-day embargo from the first integrated customer announcement, and a signed reference permission for quotes/screenshots. If Acme needs a longer embargo we can accept 45 days with a brief sign-off flow.

Next steps: please send your redline doc or confirm embargo preference and any internal approvers for brand assets.

Thanks,

Naomi Feldman
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference

Naomi — thanks for the note and doc. We want to tighten the confidentiality carveout for pre-release screenshots; Acme legal prefers explicit language that any customer-facing collateral requires written approval from our VP of Product.

On embargo: Acme's standard external communications policy is 30 days after public launch, but our PR team would like to retain a limited ability to delay if there are coordinated launch changes. Practically, can you confirm a 30-day embargo and include a clause that allows mutual written agreement to extend by up to 15 days?

I attached our redlines for your convenience.

Best,

Naomi / team — see suggested snippets below (happy to produce a single redline if helpful). My recommended approach: keep the core MSA language intact and add a short Order Form addendum with three bullets so procurement can sign off quickly. Suggested snippets:  

1) Confidentiality carveout (screenshots/quotes):
"Neither Party shall use the other Party's Confidential Information in public-facing marketing, press releases, product screenshots, or customer case studies, without the express prior written consent of the disclosing Party. For clarity, consent for use of screenshots or quotes requires written approval from the disclosing Party's VP of Product (or equivalent), provided via email or DocuSign approval."

2) Embargo window + extension: 
"Customer shall not publicly announce the implementation described in this Order Form for a period of thirty (30) days following the public launch date. The Parties may mutually agree in writing (email or signed amendment) to extend this period by up to fifteen (15) additional days. Any extension request must identify the reason and an expected new announcement date."

3) Logo use & attribution: 
"Upon receipt of a written logo usage request, the disclosing Party will provide high-resolution logo assets and brand guidelines within five (5) business days. Any use of logos shall adhere to the provided brand guidelines and include attribution as reasonably requested by the disclosing Party."

I added a short acceptance checkbox for marketing materials in the addendum to speed approvals. Attaching a text file with the snippets for easy copy/paste.

— Dev Patel
Corporate Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference

John — thanks and appreciate the speedy turnaround. Per Acme's note and Dev's suggested snippets we propose the following for the Order Form addendum (attached as PDF for legal):

- 30-day embargo from public launch with an explicit mutual extension mechanism of up to 15 days (must be in writing).
- Confidentiality carveout requiring written approval from Acme's VP of Product for screenshots/quotes; Redwood will require email sign-off from our Product Lead or CSM for any customer-supplied copy.
- Logo request turnaround and mandatory adherence to brand guidelines (5 business days to supply assets).

If that maps to Acme's requirements, we'll fold these into an addendum and send to DocuSign. I'm attaching Proposed_Publicity_Addendum.pdf with the exact language for sign-off.

Would you like Redwood to create the DocuSign envelope or will Acme push the signature? Either is fine — if you want us to send it we'll use the HubSpot deal link and reference ACME-2025-052.

Thanks — aiming to have a signed addendum by Friday so procurement can close next week.
